tasks.title: Voltage drop across the connector
tasks.statement: A current of **{i} A** flows through the connector of a 1S battery. The resistance of one contact is **{r} mΩ**, and there are two contacts in the circuit (positive and negative). Find the voltage drop across the connector in volts.
tasks.solution: R of the circuit = 2·R contact; U = I·R. Example: 10 A and 20 mΩ → 10 × 0.040 = 0.40 V. The power in the connector is P = I²·R — 4 W with the same numbers.

tasks.title: Flight time from capacity and average current
tasks.statement: A 1S **{c} mAh** cell, **{u} %** of the capacity is used, the average current in flight is **{i} A**. Find the flight time in minutes.

tasks.title: 1S sag under load
tasks.statement: The cell EMF is **{e} V**, the internal resistance of the cell is **{rc} mΩ**, the wire and connector together are **{rx} mΩ**. What voltage will the board see at a current of **{i} A**?
tasks.solution: U = E − I·(R cell + R wire and connector). Example: 3.90 V, 60 mΩ, 44 mΩ, 10 A → 3.90 − 10 × 0.104 = 2.86 V — below the 3.30 V critical threshold with a half-full cell.
